steps.title: Symptom
steps.body: Search returns last month's version 40 minutes after an accepted upload.

steps.title: Was it sent?
steps.body: The upload log shows the new version posted under the same document ID.

steps.title: Is it processed?
steps.body: processingHistory is still older than the upload. The page is accepted, not yet searchable.

steps.title: Why so slow?
steps.body: The same hour pushed 2,000 membership changes. Documents and permissions share one queue.

steps.title: Action
steps.body: Watch processing; do not re-upload. If processing is stuck, /processalldocuments reprocesses without a new upload, once every 3 hours.
